description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BecomingAParent"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LeaveNotification" name="Maternity leave notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyInformation" name="Information from company"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ParentSupport" name="Maternity leave support" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompanies" name="Notify companies" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Participant_Companies" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchInformation" name="Fetch information about potential models"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Select leave model"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Notify" name="Notify Social Security and company in time" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EndOfPeriod" name="End of leave period">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_EndOfPeriod">
        <bpmn:timeDate>leavePeriodEnd</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Decide whether to extend leave"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend leave?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExtensionSelected" name="Extension selected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtension" name="Leave ends without extension"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Fetch" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_FetchInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fetch_Select" sourceRef="Task_FetchInformation" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Collect" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Notify" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_Notify"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Gather" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_PeriodEnd" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_EndOfPeriod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEnd_Decide" sourceRef="Event_EndOfPeriod" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extension_Yes" name="Extension selected" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ExtensionSelected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${extensionChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extension_No" name="No extension" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtension"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
